title: OneCoin Adds Crypto Consumer Platform
description: For crypto consumers looking for an all-inclusive ecosystem for their cryptocurrency, look no further than OneCoin's “DealShaker” ...

asr.full_text: OneCoin adds Crypto Consumer Platform 4. Crypto consumers looking for an all-inclusive ecosystem for their cryptocurrency. Look no further than OneCoin's DealShaker, an e-commerce platform designed to enhance the OneCoin ecosystem by allowing merchants and consumers to easily use OneCoins to buy and sell goods and services. The DealShaker platform provides a double benefit for OneCoin users. Not only does Deal Shaker provide a fully integrated market place for OneCoin transactions, it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value. So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option. Only OneCoin is accepted on the Deal Shaker platform, though cash can also be used to pay for up to half of the cost goods or services, an added benefit of the system. Both consumers and merchants benefit from the DealShaker platform. By joining DealShaker, merchants gain access to the entire universe of OneCoin users, a user base that now exceeds three million users consumers gain the ability to use their one coins to purchase just about anything under the Sun what further sets one coin apart from other kryptos is it's know your customer kyc protocols which ensures that both merchants and consumers are acting in legitimate transactions 1 coins protocols ensures transparency So that both merchants and consumers can rest assured that the other party to their transactions are not acting in a criminal manner These protocols are very different from other cryptos like Bitcoin Which has become a favorite of online criminals due to the anonymity of transactions with Bitcoin. In only three months since its launch, OneCoin's DealShaker platform has grown to include 32,000 merchants and 200,000 OneCoin users. Consumers are likely to jump on board in the coming months as the platform continues to catch on with merchants and buyers.

annotation.contextual_rationale: The presentation promotes DealShaker as a OneCoin marketplace, describes OneCoin as a good option for consumers, and states that purchases use OneCoin, with cash allowed for up to half the cost. It also advances a value-increase claim and encourages merchants to join by citing access to a large user base, alongside assurances about KYC and transaction legitimacy. The branding is consistent with this promotional subject, but the records do not verify the value, growth, or assurance claims, or establish completed transactions or user outcomes.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is the best-grounded supplied subtype because the content presents OneCoin as a cryptocurrency used for marketplace purchases and links increased use of OneCoin to an asserted increase in its value. The records do not show a separate token-purchase transaction, but they do show participation in a OneCoin payment ecosystem connected to an appreciation claim.
